title: Custom Body Butter Making Class in Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Craft your own luxurious body butter in this hands-on class in Dallas. With expert instructors guiding you, explore the benefits of natural plant-based oils and essential oils tailored to your skin type. Customize your nourishing body butter with over 60 delightful non toxic fragrances while enjoying a complimentary beverage. This one-hour class is perfect for anyone looking to enhance their skincare routine and indulge in a creative experience. Let your imagination flow as you blend, mix, and personalize your body butter while enjoying the company of fellow DIY enthusiasts.
